$comment: Ported verbatim from ~/.openclaw/workspace/worker-tasks/schemas/worker-result.schema.json in M5.1 so .mjs workers (codex, claude) can submit results through this layer's queue without schema drift. Do NOT modify the shape unilaterally — if .mjs changes its result contract, this file follows; if this file changes, .mjs's normalizeWorkerResult must follow. M5.5 may consolidate ownership once the bridge stabilizes. M8.3: added optional `decisions[]` (worker-submitted decision drafts) and `appended_decision_ids[]` (submit-handler bookkeeping); validation of decision drafts is enforced in code at submit time by scripts/_decisions.append_entries_from_worker. M8.3.2: .mjs resultSchema() + normalizeWorkerResult() now carry decisions[] through (host-side file: ~/.openclaw/workspace/scripts/agent-worker.mjs); the bridge is end-to-end for decision writeback through the Mika/OpenClaw runner path.

decisions.description: M8.3: optional worker-submitted decision drafts. Each item is a WorkerDecisionDraft (decision/why required, refs/author optional). The submit handler (worker.sh submit) validates each draft, synthesizes id/ts/schema_version/adapter (from task.claimed_by_adapter — the canonical adapter token; NOT task.claimed_by which is the descriptive identifier)/repo (from task.input.repo per the canonical worker-task schema; falls back to 'unknown') and an auto-injected 'task:<task_id>' ref, then appends each as a full decision-entry to ~/.local/state/agent-continuity/decisions.jsonl. If any draft fails validation OR this field is present but not an array, the entire submit is rejected and the task remains in its current state. (M8.3.1 corrected the field-name documentation here — the original referenced task.claimed_by and task.repo_origin/task.repo, which don't match the actual worker-task schema; the implementation always used the correct fields.)

appended_decision_ids.description: M8.3: submit-handler-authoritative bookkeeping — the sha256 ids of decision entries appended to the canonical log as part of this submit. Workers must not set this; the submit handler overwrites it. Empty when no decisions[] was submitted. Provides the task -> decisions traceability mirror of the auto-injected 'task:<task_id>' ref.

WorkerDecisionDraft.description: M8.3: subset of decision-entry fields that a worker provides. The submit handler fills in the synthesized fields (schema_version, id, ts, adapter, repo) and prepends a deduped 'task:<task_id>' to refs.
